title: EV Ki Race
description: Bharat mein electric vehicle ki badhati demand ko dekhkar humne socha ki kaun sa EV sabse best hai. Is video mein hum Tata Nexon EV, Hyundai Kona Electric, aur MG ZS EV ki comparison karte hain. Jankari ke liye humne carandbike, autocarindia, aur indianexpress jaise sources ko refer kiya hai. Visuals may be AI-generated. Subscribe karein aur apne suggestions comments mein likhein.
hook: Ab Bharat mein electric vehicle ki demand badh rahi hai, lekin kaun sa EV sabse best hai? Tata Nexon EV, Hyundai Kona Electric, ya phir MG ZS EV?

scenes.narration: Electric vehicle ki demand badhne ke piche kai wajah hain, jaise ki petrol-diesel ki keemat mein badhotari aur paryavaran ke prati jagrukta. Lekin sabse badi wajah hai sarkar ki taraf se EV ko milne wali subsidy. Isse logon ko EV ki taraf aakarshit kiya ja raha hai. Ab hum dekhte hain ki Bharat mein kitne prakar ke EV uplabdh hain.

Bharat mein Tata Nexon EV, Hyundai Kona Electric, aur MG ZS EV jaise kai EV uplabdh hain. Inmein se har ek ki apni-apni visheshtaayein hain. Tata Nexon EV ki range 312 kilometer hai, jabki Hyundai Kona Electric ki range 452 kilometer hai. MG ZS EV ki range 340 kilometer hai.

Ab hum comparison karte hain in teeno EV ki features ki. Tata Nexon EV mein 30.2 kWh ki battery hai, jo 3 phase permanent magnet synchronous motor se jodi hai. Hyundai Kona Electric mein 39.2 kWh ki battery hai, jo permanent magnet synchronous motor se jodi hai. MG ZS EV mein 44.5 kWh ki battery hai, jo 3 phase permanent magnet synchronous motor se jodi hai.

In teeno EV ki price alag-alag hai. Tata Nexon EV ki shuruaati price lagbhag 14 lakh rupaye hai, jabki Hyundai Kona Electric ki shuruaati price lagbhag 23 lakh rupaye hai. MG ZS EV ki shuruaati price lagbhag 20 lakh rupaye hai.

Ab hum dekhte hain ki in teeno EV ki performance kaisi hai. Tata Nexon EV 0 se 100 kilometer per hour mein 9.9 second lagti hai, jabki Hyundai Kona Electric 0 se 100 kilometer per hour mein 9.7 second lagti hai. MG ZS EV 0 se 100 kilometer per hour mein 8.5 second lagti hai.

In teeno EV ki safety features bhi alag-alag hain. Tata Nexon EV mein dual airbags, anti-lock braking system, aur electronic stability program hai. Hyundai Kona Electric mein 6 airbags, anti-lock braking system, aur electronic stability program hai. MG ZS EV mein dual airbags, anti-lock braking system, aur electronic stability program hai.

Ab hum dekhte hain ki in teeno EV ki charging time kaisi hai. Tata Nexon EV ki charging time lagbhag 8 ghante 45 minute hai, jabki Hyundai Kona Electric ki charging time lagbhag 6 ghante 10 minute hai. MG ZS EV ki charging time lagbhag 6 ghante 30 minute hai.

In teeno EV ki warranty bhi alag-alag hai. Tata Nexon EV ki warranty 8 saal ya 1,60,000 kilometer hai, jabki Hyundai Kona Electric ki warranty 8 saal ya 1,60,000 kilometer hai. MG ZS EV ki warranty 8 saal ya 1,50,000 kilometer hai.

Ab hum dekhte hain ki in teeno EV ki resale value kaisi hai. Tata Nexon EV ki resale value lagbhag 60% hai, jabki Hyundai Kona Electric ki resale value lagbhag 55% hai. MG ZS EV ki resale value lagbhag 50% hai.

Ant mein hum kehte hain ki in teeno EV mein se kaun sa sabse best hai, yeh aapke budget aur jarurat par nirbhar karta hai. Agar aapke paas kam budget hai, to Tata Nexon EV sabse best hai. Agar aapke paas zyada budget hai, to Hyundai Kona Electric sabse best hai.
